name: com.patternswizard/pattern-stats
title: PatternsWizard pattern and indicator statistics
description: Tested statistics of 179 chart and candlestick patterns and 362 indicator strategies, six markets.

tools.name: search_patterns
tools.description: List tested patterns with their headline result on one market and timeframe. Filter by name, family, direction or verdict, for example: which chart patterns beat chance on forex 4h. Patterns recorded on both breakout sides have no all row and are not listed: read them with get_pattern_stats.

query.description: Words of the pattern name, e.g. "engulfing", "head and shoulders".

family.description: Pattern family (harmonic patterns are in chart).

market.description: Market. all pools the markets that have this timeframe. Default: all.

timeframe.description: Bar timeframe. Default: 1d. Stocks, ETFs, indices and commodities have 1d and 1w only.

verdict.description: Keep only this verdict (on the measure chosen with measure).

measure.description: move: excess 10-bar return over the rest of the market (verdict). trade: 2:1 trade versus the same trade on random dates (verdictTrade). Default: move.

min_occurrences.description: Keep only results with at least this many occurrences.

sort.description: occurrences (default), excess (excess return, best first), trade (expectancy minus its random baseline, best first) or name.

limit.description: Maximum number of patterns returned. Default: 50.

tools.name: get_pattern_stats
tools.description: Full tested results of one pattern: detection rule, trade rules and every market, timeframe and breakout side measured, with confidence intervals, q-values, verdicts, timing quartiles and the page URL to cite.

pattern.description: Pattern id (e.g. engulfing_bullish), page URL or slug, or name (e.g. "bullish engulfing").

market.description: Keep only this market. Default: every market.

timeframe.description: Keep only this timeframe. Default: every timeframe.

side.description: Keep only this breakout side. Default: every side.

tools.name: compare_patterns
tools.description: Put 2 to 10 patterns side by side on the same market, timeframe and breakout side.

market.description: Market. all pools the markets that have this timeframe. Default: all.

timeframe.description: Bar timeframe. Default: 1d. Stocks, ETFs, indices and commodities have 1d and 1w only.

side.description: Breakout side. Patterns recorded on both sides have up and down rows and no all row; every other pattern has only all. Default: all.

tools.name: search_indicators
tools.description: List the trading strategies taught on the indicator pages (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger Bands...) with their tested result against the rest of the market, after costs. Filter by indicator name, direction or verdict, for example: which indicator strategies beat the market on crypto daily bars. Without market and timeframe, each strategy gives its headline row.

query.description: Words of the indicator or strategy name, e.g. "rsi", "golden cross", "bollinger".

direction.description: bullish: buy signals, bearish: sell signals, neutral: signals without direction (measured on the range of the next moves).

market.description: Market. all pools the markets that have this timeframe. Default: the headline row of each strategy.

timeframe.description: Bar timeframe. Default: the headline row of each strategy, or 1d when a market is given.

sort.description: vs_market (best first, the default), signals (most signals first) or name.

limit.description: Maximum number of strategies returned. Default: 50.

tools.name: get_indicator_stats
tools.description: Full tested results of one indicator page: every strategy it teaches (entry and exit rules), on every market and timeframe, with status, robustness reserves and the page URL to cite.

indicator.description: Indicator name (e.g. "RSI", "MACD"), page URL or slug, or a strategy id returned by search_indicators.

market.description: Keep only this market. Default: every market.

timeframe.description: Keep only this timeframe. Default: every timeframe.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: How the statistics are computed: principles, the meaning of every field and verdict, and data coverage (assets and date range per market and timeframe). The indicators key holds the same for indicator strategies.
